changes: New: Ghost Cut, a microlooper on FX2. GRAB loops a tempo-synced piece of the track (LEN 1/64 to 1/4); let go and the track fades back.
TAPE plays the loop from a quarter speed to almost four times; GRAIN keeps that speed and sets the pitch with PTCH (±24 semitones).
DRFT adds a second head that drifts against the first over MOTN bars (1/4 to 32), in stereo on TAPE.
CAPT loops the last LEN, the next LEN or the ring as it was; DIR plays forwards, backwards or back and forth.
Not yet tried on a unit.
